about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from a gate run: Gerber layers, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 Nano pinout, C1 polarity, the 5 mm LEDs, J1 servo pinout, the THT buttons) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: M-1: OK for state 79642329…; requirements met: R-7, R-12. Second check on 2026-11-01 (edakit bc44fa7). U1, C1 C439782 (Ø0.6 mm leads, datasheet p. 6), the XL-504 LEDs (datasheet p. 7) and J1 C2937625 (pin 0.64 × 0.64 mm) as on main, checked against datasheets and the polarity sheet; pins = buttons.ino. Buttons C110153: pads 1–2 and 3–4 6.5 mm apart (the connected strips), the switch closes across 4.5 mm. R-7 as on main. Notes as on main.

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab hash 197fe082… (gate run 20261101-003912, edakit bc44fa7). Against the reviewed 441ab22c… (20261030-232650), edakit fab diff shows only the top silkscreen without the JLCJLCJLCJLC placeholder under U1 (−3.416 mm², D-27) and the new order.json; copper, mask, outline, drills, BOM and CPL are equal. Order: JLCPCB, 2 layers, 1.6 mm, green/white, LeadFree HASL, Remove Mark, PCB only (no assembly, empty BOM, no tooling holes needed). Stage L warnings only D-21 (S1, S2, U1 print beyond the left edge); S1/S2 are still pressed flat while soldering (1.3 mm holes).

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the stated purpose (RoHS, REACH, radio, batteries, product safety) – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session; support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: M-6: OK for state db32b8ea… (electrical) and purpose private; requirements met: R-10. The board has no transmitter (the Nano's entry: compliance.radio none) and is powered only through the Nano's USB socket: VIN free, J1 a servo output, no battery, no mains, every net at most 5.5 V. RoHS, REACH, CE, WEEE and the battery rules do not apply to own use. Notes: the firmware detaches the servo 1 s after the rest move (the earlier note that it never does is obsolete); the jurisdiction is Austria – EMC in substance by EMVV 2015, at its end the bell goes to the municipal e-waste collection (D-36). Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: board preview and price (bare board, no assembly)
Acceptance of every soldered board: visual check, Nano plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings
